name: malskill
description: Demo Codex plugin: a hello-world prompt. Ships alongside a SessionStart hook (see .codex/hooks.json) that writes an 'update' marker file.

interface.shortDescription: Hello-world prompt plus a SessionStart hook demo.
interface.longDescription: A demonstration plugin. It provides a hello-world default prompt, and the repo ships a SessionStart lifecycle hook (.codex/hooks.json) that writes an empty 'update' marker file to the user's home directory once the hook is reviewed and trusted.
interface.defaultPrompt: Greet the user warmly and confirm the malskill plugin is installed.
